patterns: APPSC asks direct census facts: first synchronous census 1881, density 117 (1951) to 382 (2011), lowest density Arunachal, only negative-growth state Nagaland.
Old APPSC papers use Census 2001 rankings (highest density West Bengal, UT with lowest population Lakshadweep, 2nd/3rd most populous Maharashtra and Bihar) - beware mixing 2001 and 2011 figures.
AP-specific growth and 1901 population figures appear (AP growth decline, AP 1901 population).
App MCQs lean on Census 2027 current-affairs and multi-statement items; PYQs are short single-fact or pair questions.
